text.tspan: S5 Deployment drivers and deployed-state sense (SQSO-EPS-BRD-001)
SQSO-HW-DIAG-001 · dashed = part not selected · values from the board build-to designs
One current-limited driver per burn resistor, two resistors per wing (REL-03, chair decision).
Chain for each resistor: DS1, DS2, DS3 (bus, S1) -> SW6 (DEPLOY_EN, high side) -> U17 burn buck
-> resistor -> driver FET (burn line AND one-shot). The FSW burns one resistor at a time for 8 s,
the second of a wing only if it has not released.
Pack current: one resistor 0.67 A (housekeeping and heater included); four at once (software
fault) are held by U17's current limit to 2.0 A, below the 4.0 A BMS trip and the 5 A fuse.
One-shot: a stuck-high line burns 12 s once; only a falling edge re-arms it.
Regulates for burn resistors up to 6.9 Ohm.
Switches closed when deployed: low = both wings deployed.
AntS (J12): 3V3_ANTS from SW8 (DEPLOY_EN, 1.37 A limit); I2C2 through U80 TCA9517
(isolated while the AntS is unpowered). The AntS's own ARM and knives complete its chain
(DS1, DS2, DS3, SW8, AntS ARM). ANTENNA_SENSE (PB11) is no longer wired.
